{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify the number of unique patients after deduplication
num_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Compute response rate by site
df_response_rate = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Sort by response rate descending
df_response_rate_sorted = df_response_rate.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the site with the highest response rate
highest_site = df_response_rate_sorted.index[0]
highest_rate = df_response_rate_sorted.iloc[0]

# Print all required values
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {num_patients}")
print(f"Response rates by site:")
print(df_response_rate_sorted)
print(f"Highest response rate: {highest_rate} at site {highest_site}")"}
